referenceFunction.generalComment: Disposal of special components of a ventilation system for a residential care home with apartments, kitchen, cafe/restaurant, multi-purpose hall, wellness area and laundry. The inventory is based on a building with a total heated gross floor area of 9844 m2 and a total nominal air flow of 34460 m3/h, total weight of the components: 1576 kg/Unit, building with a specific air flow rate of 3.5 m3/h per m2 heated gross floor area. Data from call of bid including components for commercial kitchen with exhaust and supply air ceiling system mainly made of stainless steel and aluminium. Stainless steel exhaust air hood for kitchen. No ducts included.; UUID: ad974c67-9be1-405d-98c7-8c40e5121377
